auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mfa.expired: Verification expired. Please sign in again.

forgotPage.title: Forgot password
forgotPage.subtitle: Enter your email address: if an account exists, you will receive a reset link valid for 30 minutes.
forgotPage.sent: If an account matches this address, an email has been sent. Remember to check your spam folder.

reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. All your open sessions will be signed out.
reset.done: Password changed. You can now sign in.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Please make a new request.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.subtitle: You are invited to join {company}.
invitation.existing: An account already exists for {email}. Enter your password to accept.
invitation.done: Invitation accepted. Sign in to access your workspace.
invitation.invalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or has already been used.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitle: Protect your account with a temporary code generated by your phone.
mfa.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
mfa.step1: 1. Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis…).
mfa.step2: 2. Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code shown to confirm.
mfa.recoveryHelp: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one allows a single sign-in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
mfa.regenerateHelp: Previous codes will be invalidated. Enter a code from your app to confirm.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices currently signed in to your account.
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other session} one {# session signed out} other {# sessions signed out}}

platform.loginSubtitle: Reserved for ECSI super administrators. Two-factor authentication required.
platform.consoleSubtitle: Customer company management. Every platform action is recorded in the audit log.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.notFound: Item not found or outside your scope.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: Your WiFi operating locations: zones, shops, branches.
sites.emptyDescription: No site matches, or no site is assigned to you.
sites.notFoundDescription: This site does not exist or is outside your scope.
sites.deleteDescription: The site will be removed from its groups and from user access. Its audit history is kept.
sites.noGroups: This site belongs to no group.
sites.upcomingDescription: MikroTik routers, hotspots, vendors, plans and sales for this site will be attached here in upcoming sprints.

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Unique within the company, e.g. SITE-COCODY.
form.coordinatesTogether: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.

routers.title: MikroTik routers
routers.subtitle: Routers of your sites, connected to ECSI CLOUD through an encrypted WireGuard tunnel.
routers.searchPlaceholder: Name, identity, model or tunnel address
routers.deleteDescription: The router leaves the list and is no longer monitored; its tunnel is removed from the gateway. The operation is recorded in the audit log.
routers.emptyDescription: Add a router: ECSI CLOUD generates a script to paste in its terminal, with no public IP or port forwarding.
routers.notFoundDescription: This router does not exist, was disabled or does not belong to your sites.

enroll.title: Add a router
enroll.intro: Choose the site and the router name. ECSI CLOUD assigns its tunnel address and generates a single-use RouterOS v7 script.
enroll.name: Router name
enroll.scriptOnce: This script contains a single-use token: it is shown only once and expires on {expiresAt}.
enroll.step1: Open a terminal on the router (WinBox > New Terminal, or SSH) as an administrator.
enroll.step2: Paste the whole script: the router generates its WireGuard key, which never leaves it.
enroll.step3: The router connects to ECSI CLOUD (works behind NAT, CGNAT or Starlink).
enroll.step4: It shows as “Online” after the first collection, at tunnel address {tunnelIp}.

credentials.title: Change RouterOS credentials
credentials.intro: After renewing the service account on the router, enter its new credentials. The password is encrypted on receipt and will never be shown again.
credentials.fingerprintHint: SHA-256 of the www-ssl certificate; leave empty to keep the current one.

siteGroups.title: Site groups
siteGroups.subtitle: Group your sites for ECSI roaming: one ticket will work on every site of a group.
siteGroups.name: Name
siteGroups.codeHint: Unique within the company, e.g. GROUPE-ABIDJAN.
siteGroups.emptyDescription: Create a group to prepare roaming between your sites.
siteGroups.deleteDescription: Sites are not deleted, only removed from the group.
siteGroups.siteCount: {count, plural, =0 {No sites} one {# site} other {# sites}}

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Your company’s identity, contact details and general settings.
company.profileSubtitle: This information appears on your tickets and documents.
company.readOnly: Read only: only a company administrator can edit the profile.
company.name: Trade name
company.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 512 KB maximum.
company.logoType: Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP.
company.settingsSubtitle: Display preferences shared across the company.
company.supportMessageHint: Shown to hotspot customers (upcoming sprints), e.g. a number to call.

members.title: Users
members.subtitle: Company members, roles and per-site access.
members.inviteSubtitle: The person receives a link valid for 7 days. You can only grant rights you hold.
members.chooseSitesError: Choose at least one site for each site-scoped role.
members.name: Name
members.notFoundDescription: This member does not exist or is outside your scope.
members.selfNotice: This is your account: your own roles and access are managed by another administrator.
members.editRolesHint: Their sessions in the company will be closed to apply the new rights.
members.deactivated: User disabled: their sessions are closed.
members.removeDescription: Their personal account is kept, but they lose all access to this company. Their sessions are closed.
members.mfaResetDescription: The old secret is deleted (never shown). The person will set up a new app at next sign-in. All their sessions are closed and the action is logged.
members.mfaResetOtherCompanies: This account also belongs to another company: recovery must be done by ECSI support.
members.mfaResetReasonHint: E.g. lost phone, identity verified by call.
members.mfaResetDone: Two-factor authentication reset. The person was notified by email.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every sensitive action, timestamped and tamper-evident. No password or secret is recorded.

companies.title: Customer companies
companies.subtitle: Create, view, suspend. Every action is logged.
companies.createSubtitle: The first administrator receives an invitation and chooses their own password.
companies.slugHint: Optional: derived from the name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).
companies.total: {count, plural, =0 {No companies} one {# company} other {# companies}}
companies.suspended: Company suspended: its users are signed out.
companies.reactivateDescription: Its users will be able to sign in again.
companies.suspendDescription: All company sessions are closed immediately and no access is possible until reactivation. Data is kept.
companies.reasonHint: Required, recorded in the audit log.

audit.title: Global audit log
audit.subtitle: Actions across all companies and the platform.
audit.integritySubtitle: Each event is chained to the previous one by a SHA-256 hash: any change or deletion is detected.

support.title: Support: 2FA recovery
support.subtitle: For a user who lost their authenticator app, after verifying their identity.
support.resetDescription: The old secret is deleted without being shown, all their sessions are closed, and the action appears in the log of each of their companies.
